content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"P035","reason":"Automatic Data Processing sells cloud payroll, HR and tax-filing software plus outsourced payroll services to employers, the same software-plus-service model as Intuit's payroll offering."},{"label":"P254","reason":"Paylocity sells subscription payroll and HR software with payroll tax filing and implementation services to mid-sized employers, closely matching Intuit's payroll business."},{"label":"P253","reason":"Paycom sells cloud payroll and HR software with payroll processing and tax filing to US employers, mainly small and mid-sized businesses, similar to Intuit's payroll line."},{"label":"P030","reason":"Asure Software sells cloud payroll, HR, tax filing and compliance software to small and mid-sized employers, much like Intuit's small business payroll products."},{"label":"P041","reason":"Barrett Business Services provides payroll and HR administration plus tax and benefits services to small and mid-sized businesses, overlapping Intuit's small business payroll services."},{"label":"P339","reason":"Thryv sells monthly business management software and digital marketing services to small businesses, overlapping Intuit's small business software and marketing offerings."},{"label":"P153","reason":"Gen Digital sells subscription tax, identity and personal finance tools to individual consumers, overlapping Intuit's consumer personal finance and tax products."},{"label":"P267","reason":"Priority Technology provides payment processing and B2B payables software to small and mid-sized businesses, overlapping Intuit's payments and invoicing tools."},{"label":"P100","reason":"Dave sells a subscription personal finance app with fees on instant transfers, overlapping Intuit's consumer personal finance apps, though its banking focus is narrower."}]}
